Container.Name: shutterlift
Container.Overview:
ShutterLift — upload new photos and videos from a folder to Google Photos, with a web interface.
• Watches a folder and uploads new files on a schedule • Each file is uploaded once; history is kept locally • Duplicate check by file fingerprint, so copies of the same photo are skipped • Photos you delete in Google Photos are not uploaded again • Subfolders become albums; files in the top folder go to the library • Dashboard, history, log and Google sign-in in the browser
Needs your own Google Cloud OAuth client (Desktop app) with the Photos Library API enabled. Uses rclone for the upload. Not affiliated with Google.
Container.Requires: A Google Cloud project with the Photos Library API enabled and an OAuth client of type "Desktop app". Setup steps are in the project README.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Settings, upload history and the Google login. Keep it on appdata.

Config.Name: Photo folder
Config.Description: The folder to watch. Read only is enough.

Config.Name: TZ
Config.Description: Time zone for dates and the schedule.

Config.Name: Web password
Config.Description: Optional. If set, the web interface asks for this password (any user name).
